CUB.name: Cuba
CUB.note: Cuba does not directly elect its president. In March 2023 all 470 candidates were elected to the 470-seat National Assembly (75.9% turnout); in April the Assembly re-elected Miguel Díaz-Canel. The parliamentary figures are not multiparty vote shares.

pres.note: The final CEP tally was issued January 3, 2017. Its 1,062,839 valid votes include 7,203 ‘no candidate’ choices.
